name: Girls on the Run Bay Area Junior Coach
org: Girls on the Run Bay Area
what_you_do: You coach elementary and middle school girls. The program covers running and life skills. You are a junior coach. You work 1.5 to 3 hours a week for 8 to 10 weeks.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 18 and in high school. The page says teens on Heart&Sole teams must identify as female, and males are welcome on Girls on the Run teams. Needs a completed reference, a signed waiver (parent signs if under 18) and the Junior Coach application. Background check at 18.
duration: 8 to 10 weeks, 1.5 to 3 hours per week; season starts early September, 5K on Nov 14, 2026
deadline_text: The fall 2026 Junior Coach application was due Aug 26, 2026 (season started early September; 5K on Nov 14, 2026). Spring dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Complete the Junior Coach application on the Girls on the Run Bay Area site. Email admin@gotrbayarea.org or call (415) 863-8942 to ask about late spots or the next season.
notes: The Oct 12, 2026 date on the sf.gov listing is for adult coaches (18 and up), not Junior Coaches. Teams meet at least once a week.
